GREAT HUNTER GETS
WILD DUCK
VISIT

Edd C. Jones had not gone hunting—not specially after wild ducks—yesterday, but the day ended with a fine one bagged. In some manner the fowl became entangled in a high wire over the back yard at the residence of Mr. Jones and was so badly wounded that it fell. The noise it made attracted attention and it was easily bagged before it recovered sufficiently to get away.
